Are there any exclusive offers available for Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8? Yes, purchasing the new Galaxy Z Foldable in Malaysia includes bank rebate of up to RM500 off from six partner banks, 5x Samsung Rewards burn capped at RM400, and a complimentary 25W Travel Adapter via Live Commerce voucher. Are there any gifts with purchase if I buy Galaxy Z8 Foldables? Yes, the new Galaxy Z Foldable buyers in Malaysia will receive a complimentary 25W Travel Adapter via Live Commerce voucher. What are on-going promo to purchase a Galaxy Z series? The on-going new Galaxy Z Foldable series promo in Malaysia features up to RM500 rebate from six partner banks (Maybank, CIMB, UOB, HSBC, RHB, and Ambank, valid until 4 October for Online purchases), 5x Samsung Rewards burn capped at RM400, and a complimentary 25W Travel Adapter via Live Commerce. Can I utilize my Samsung rewards to get discounts? Yes, you can use Samsung Rewards to save on your new Galaxy Z Foldable purchase in Malaysia. Buyers can burn 5x Samsung Rewards points capped at RM400. Terms and conditions apply What are the bundle offers for Galaxy Z series? Enjoy a 30% discount on accessories and 10% on Wearables purchased with the new Galaxy Z Foldable series in Malaysia, when you bundle them with your new Galaxy Z Foldable. Smartphone MBO Eco Program T&Cs ACCS MO Promotion July - Sept 26 T&Cs Can I trade in my current device when buying a Galaxy Z Series smartphone? Yes, you can trade in your current device when buying the new Galaxy Z Foldable smartphone in Malaysia. Samsung Trade-In applies an instant discount at checkout based on your old device model and condition, and your device is collected on delivery. What are the best offers and discounts for Galaxy Z8 Foldables? Galaxy Z8 Series buyers in Malaysia can enjoy exclusive launch rewards worth up to RM1,909.90. This includes an exclusive rebate of up to RM800, a Samsung Rewards Points Booster worth up to RM400, an instant RM500 rebate with selected bank cards, and a 12-month Premium VIP subscription worth RM209.90. You also get a 6-month Google AI Pro trial worth RM587.94, up to 30% off accessories, and trade-in savings of up to RM3,145. Terms and conditions apply Can I purchase Galaxy Z Fold8 with 0% instalments? Yes. The Galaxy Z8 Series is eligible for 0% fees instalment for up to 36 months through SPayLater and Maybank credit card. Select your preferred plan in the payment section at checkout. ^Typical capacity is 390 mAh (20 % increase compared to previous Galaxy Watch8 40 mm) for 40 mm size, 445 mAh (10 mAh increase compared to previous Galaxy Watch8 44 mm) for 44 mm size.
